## Added
- Image controls: proportional resizing, a zoom viewer, non-destructive crop with rule-of-thirds guides, private image notes, and native image clipboard support.
- Block marquee selection with shared bulk actions.
- Spreadsheet-style table controls: header strips to select, insert and delete columns and rows, and a + at each end.
- A right-click option on images and media to show the name below instead of as a tooltip.
- A full emoji picker for page and workspace icons: the complete offline Unicode 17.0 catalog with search, categories and paging, including skin tones, families and flags.

## Improved
- Column controls stay visible while the caret is inside the columns block.
- Image names show as a tooltip by default.
- Text fields use border focus styling.

## Fixed
- Columns blocks and blocks that are the only content of a container can now be deleted, and blocks inside columns can delete the whole columns block.
